source.criterion: Its authority, version, semantics, access and reconciliation with actual systems are adequate for the decisions made from it.

receiver.bearer: A bounded work path from demand to beneficiary outcome
receiver.criterion: Include waiting before entry, rework and downstream delay when comparing local cycle times.

guard: The literal common work/evidence/commitment object, actual receiving use, actor, configuration, population and useful time window are identified.
The named input changes an actual native receiving inquiry. Shared words, generic co-use and an invented extra process are insufficient.
A material partial contribution need not establish the complete receiving criterion. Remaining evidence, competence, validity, authority and demonstrated effects stay separate.
The counterexample tests a stronger claim; its failure does not erase the guarded input. Known absence of the actual use defeats this instance, while missing correspondence stays unknown.

Stage boundaries, coherent work units, full safe transition costs and sustainable workload apply at their actual native scope; neither smaller batches nor stable cadence nor more visibility is universally preferable.

Use the same identified work item, actual receiving decision, boundary, population and time horizon; keep unknown correspondence unknown. Each bridge is a partial input with the remaining native criterion explicitly unsatisfied by it alone.

member_to_premise_evidence.nontrigger: Actual common use is absent; the guard is not established merely by giving both methods a name. Unknown applicability is not a global negative.
specific_cost_and_alternative: Compare complete same-use costs: preparation, capture, maintenance, repeated verification, independent judgment, coordination, waiting, downstream support, recovery and opportunity cost. Do not count the same wait twice as both labour and identical lost value without a stated model.

Retain larger coherent batches with expensive fixed qualification, small incremental internal builds, direct owned records instead of boards, manual evidence at low cadence, event-driven reviews, finite-capacity planning for novel work, and no change when a new control has no justified benefit.

Actual authority and binding duties remain constraints rather than cost terms that can be silently optimized away.
